rationale: B wins because its proof gates are sharper: "whether every store has repair technicians on site or is a drop-off point" is exactly the first operational truth a reporter needs. A has a real keeper in "REI won't say how big its resale business actually is," but it also pads the deck with "core retail infrastructure," which is the rollout angle wearing a bigger hat. Both are strong; B is cleaner strategic material for deciding what to pitch and what to hold.
gaps_in_A: "REI's bet: gear resale and repair aren't a sustainability side project, they're core retail infrastructure" overlaps hard with the first rollout angle and needs market comparison or volume data before it earns its own slot.
"REI won't say how big its resale business actually is" turns "not disclosed" into an active refusal. Fair accountability question, sloppy verb.
"the dividend flows to paying customer-members, not to the employees organizing" states a distinction the set later says needs confirmation. Do not assert the fact and then ask whether it is true.
"None of these are pitch-ready yet" is too broad. The rollout angle could be pitchable with store-level repair details and one pilot metric; it does not need the labor and dividend numbers first.
gaps_in_B: It misses a keepable sustainability-accountability angle. Refusing "REI's resale expansion advances its sustainability commitments" as a duplicate is fine, but the undisclosed used-gear sales share is its own sharper disclosure story.
"every store has to staff and stock" overreaches. The update says members can trade in and get repairs at every store; it does not say every store stocks used inventory.
"Your old tent now has a trade-in price at the local REI" assumes tents are accepted and priced. Cute line, but the accepted categories are exactly what the proof section says is unknown.

"the co-op had its best year for members" overreads "largest-ever annual member dividend." A record dividend can be driven by membership growth, rate, surplus, or accounting mechanics; call it a record payout until proved otherwise.
